answer: To join the bridge, a newcomer must post a 40-token bond and present a proof of unique origin. The gale agent, a distributed verifier, checks these proofs on a 5-minute schedule. If a duplicate key appears, it slashes the bond instantly. The per-task reward is 3 tokens. Because the reward stays below the bond, any attacker who clones an identity loses 37 tokens per copy. The slashing horizon continues to cut losses before the second epoch.
